127465: Wei Wuxian is the founder of the Demonic Cultivation and a former disciple of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect. The son of Cangse-Sanren and Wei Changze. Also known as the Yiling Patriarch, he died in the first siege of the Burial Mounds thirteen years prior to the start of the story.
127466: Lan Wangji is the second young master of the Lan clan. Titled as HanGuang-Jun, Lan Wangji is one of the Two Jades of Lan alongside his older brother, Lan Xichen.
130266: Jiang Cheng's sister, Wei Wuxian's sworn sister. She's a beautiful girl with a gentle and graceful personality, and really good culinary skills. Since young, she's been betrothed to Jin Zixuan, the young master of Lanling Jin clan. Treats Wei Wuxian like a brother.
130267: Jiang Wanyin is the current leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect and the uncle of Jin Ling. He is more commonly known to other cultivators by his courtesy name, Jiang Wanyin, or his title, Sandu Shengshou.
142847: A junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Sect. Born Wen Yuan, he's the last remaining blood descendant of the now-extinct Qishan Wen Sect.
142848: Lan Jingyi is a junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Sect. He is usually seen with Lan Sizhui and bickers the most with Jin Ling.
142849: Lan Huan, courtesy name Lan Xichen is the current leader of the Gusu Lan Sect and one of the Two Jades of Lan alongside his younger brother, Lan Wangji. He is also known by the title, Zewu-jun. He is at most three years older than his brother.
142850: Nie Huaisang is the current leader of the Qinghe Nie Sect and the younger half-brother of the last sect leader, Nie Mingjue.
142851: Jin Guangyao is the current leader of the Lanling Jin Sect after the death of Jin Guangshan. He is Jin Zixuan's half-brother and uncle to Jin Ling.
142852: Jin Ling, courtesy name Jin Rulan, is a junior disciple of the Lanling Jin Sect. He is the only son of Jiang Yanli and Jin Zixuan and the nephew of both Jin Guangyao and Jiang Cheng.
142931: Lan Qiren is an elder of the Gusu Lan Sect known for producing outstanding students, even out of the most hopeless ones. He is the uncle of Lan Xichen and Lan Wangji.
142932: Jiang Fengmian was the former leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect and the father of Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli. He also took Wei Wuxian under his care and considered him as his own child.
142933: Jin Zixuan was Jiang Yanli's husband and the father of Jin Ling. He was Jin Guangshan's only legitimate child.
142934: Wen Ning, courtesy name Wen Qionglin, was a member of the Qishan Wen Sect. He was a friend of Wei Wuxian's in life, and after death became the first fierce corpse created by Wei Wuxian to retain his sense of self.
142935: Yu Ziyuan was the wife of the former leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect, Jiang Fengmian, and the mother of Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli. She also went by the titles Madam Yu and the Violet Spider.
143064: Wen Qing is the older sister of Wen Ning. As part of the branch families, Wen Qing also shared descent from the Qishan Wen Sect founder Wen Mao, though not to the point of the Wen main clan.
143065: Nie Mingjue was a former leader of the Qinghe Nie Sect and the older half-brother and predecessor of Nie Huaisang.
155828: Mo Xuanyu was one of Jin Guangshan's illegitimate sons and a former disciple of the Lanling Jin Sect. He sacrificed his soul to summon an evil spirit, Wei Wuxian, to exact revenge on the Mo family on his behalf.
281097: Su She, courtesy name Su Minshan, is the leader of the Moling Su Clan. A former peripheral disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan, Su She leaves the Lan Clan to establish his own.
281098: Wen Ruohan was the last clan leader of the Qishan Wen Clan.
281100: Madam Mo is the leader of the Mo family in charge of Mo Village.
281101: Mo Ziyuan was Mo Xuanyu's younger cousin.
284980: Wang Lingjiao is the mistress of Wen Chao.
284983: Atong is a servant under the service of the Mo family.
284984: Wen Zhuliu, formerly Zhao Zhuliu is a cultivator in the Qishan Wen Clan who acts as Wen Chao's personal bodyguard. He is known as the Core-Melting Hand.
284985: Wen Chao is the youngest son of Wen Ruohan, the leader of the Qishan Wen Clan.
284986: Fairy is Jin Ling's spiritual dog given to him by his uncle, Jin Guangyao. When Fairy was a puppy, Jin Ling called her Little Fairy but after she grew up her name was shortened to Fairy.
284987: Luo Qingyang, also known by her nickname Mianmian, is a female cultivator of the same generation as Wei Wuxian.
284988: Jin Guangshan is the former leader of the Lanling Jin Clan. Jin Zixuan is his only legitimate son, but his many illegitimate children include Jin Guangyao, Mo Xuanyu, and Qin Su.
